Subject: Recycled Paper Runs Start May 8

Hello printmakers,

Starting May 8, our print shop will begin accepting recycled paper stocks for studio runs and small editions. We want to support greener materials without sacrificing crisp ink coverage. If you have a specific sheet in mind, please bring a sample by the counter so we can test it together.

Subject: Sustainable stock options at the press

We are expanding what goes through our presses this spring. Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper across standard runs, making it easier to produce editions with lower material waste. Artists interested in testing texture and ink absorption should bring a sample when stopping by the studio.
